customManagers.description: Track container image tags pinned inside HelmRelease values. The flux manager only sees chart versions, so an image pinned to work around a stale chart would otherwise never be updated.

packageRules.description: 13ft restarted its numbering: 1.x tags (2024) are OLDER than 0.5.0 (2026-09). Stay on 0.x until upstream passes 1.3.
Patch updates are low risk and can merge themselves. Overridden for Cilium and local-path-provisioner below.
Group minor bumps of the supporting stack into one reviewable PR.
SearXNG tags are YYYY.M.D-<commit>. Docker versioning treats the commit as a compatibility suffix that never matches the next release, so updates would stall without this.

local-path-provisioner owns every persistent volume in the cluster, and its chart is still 0.0.x, so even a z-bump can change provisioning behaviour. Never automerged. Listed after the patch rule so it overrides it.

Cilium is the CNI and the kube-proxy replacement. A bad upgrade takes cluster networking with it, so it is never automerged and always lands on its own. Listed last so it overrides the patch-automerge rule above.
Flux's own controllers are upgraded with `flux bootstrap`, which rewrites gotk-components.yaml. Renovate must not edit that file or the two will fight.
